spec.note: POST-HOC ADD-ONS to spec_rigid_v1.json (NOT part of the frozen analysis; no Holm family; every contrast descriptive and unadjusted). Written 09-26 by the final E6b analysis after the interim f104 look of 09-25 14:10 but BEFORE this session built the index or looked at any unseen / held-out / dev outcome. Adds: speed-free and fail-label seed floors (a vs b ensembles), fixed-2 M2/A3-vs-M3 on fail, the backward-only share of unsafe, model vs straight 2 m/s, in-arena effects per held-out arena, dev fail contrasts, the generalisation gap against the g203 / g228 held-out groups (in distribution for M3 / A3, unseen arenas for M1 / M2 on g228 and M1 on both), unsafe dose response speed free.
